Peninsular Petroleum Corporation 
 
 PSU CLIENT · Maharashtra · IN 
 
 
 RefeRence LetteR 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern 
 
 Ref: REF/11/121 Date: March 31, 2026 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern, 
 
 This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the
 
 said agency has executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their
 performance has been found satisfactory. 
 
 1. PRoject DetaiLs 
 
 
 Project Name Pipeline Laying - Maharashtra Pkg-140 
 
 Scope of Work Water Supply works for Peninsular Petroleum Corporation
 completed 2019. 
 
 Nature of Work Water Supply 
 
 Contract Value INR 2.82 Cr 
 
 Date of Completion 2019-08-28 
 
 Contractor's Role JV Partner 
 
 
 2. PeRfoRmance assessment 
 
 Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was prompt and well documented, and . On
 that basis the agency would be considered favourably for similar assignments.
 
 
 Criterion Rating Observation 
 
 Adherence to Schedule Excellent Project delivered within contractual timeline
 Quality of Work Excellent Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications
 
 Safety Record Good BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout 
 
 Responsiveness Excellent Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs 
 
 Financial Integrity Good Billing was accurate and supported by records
 
 
 
 
 DOC-REF-121 Page 1 of 2

3. RecommenDation 
 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and
 cost, and their conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for similar
 
 works. 
 We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar
 
 assignments in the future. This reference is valid for a period of Medium from the date of this
 letter. 
 
 
 4. VeRification 
 
 For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in.
 This letter is issued upon specific request of the contractor and does not constitute any commitment or guarantee for
 future engagements. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Debasish Menon 
 Project Director 
 Peninsular Petroleum Corporation
 Maharashtra, India
